title: OpenAI investors must consider latest CFO comments

content_html:
Peace Longe

Mon, August 17, 2026 at 12:17 PM CDT 5 min read

OpenAI has spent years being known for one thing: ChatGPT, and the millions of people who type questions into it every day.

However, that is no longer where most of its money comes from.

On Friday, August 14, 2026, OpenAI Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar met with investors and told them the company's enterprise business now brings in more revenue than its consumer business.

The timing stood out. Two senior executives had just left the company that same week.

This matters for anyone watching OpenAI ahead of a possible public listing, and it changes how the company looks as an investment.

Sarah Friar tells OpenAI investors enterprise revenue now beats consumer

Sarah Friar gave investors a clear message about how OpenAI makes its money.

Friar said enterprise and consumer revenue "have now crossed," after starting the year at a 60-40 split favoring consumer, according to a person who attended the meeting, CNBC reported.

She added that the majority of OpenAI's revenue now comes from enterprise customers.

"Enterprise" means business customers, such as companies that buy ChatGPT Enterprise seats or pay to use OpenAI's models inside their own software. 

"Consumer" means individuals paying for ChatGPT subscriptions, like the $20-a-month Plus tier.

The crossover came rapidly. OpenAI started 2026 with 60% of its revenue from consumers and 40% from its enterprise business. 

Friar had previously said the two sides would reach parity by the end of the year. 

The revenue numbers behind OpenAI's enterprise shift

The figures Friar shared point to fast growth across the business.

OpenAI's yearly revenue pace has hit $40 billion. That figure jumped 20% in July alone, and the number of business customers grew 32% in that same month.

An annualized run rate works like this: take one month's revenue and multiply it out as if every month this year looked the same. 

It shows how fast the company is moving right now. It does not promise the year will actually add up to that total.

Key OpenAI revenue figures from the August 14 meeting

  • $40 billion annualized run rate: Roughly double the pace from late 2025, CNBC confirmed.

  • 20% month-over-month growth: Total company revenue pace rose that much in July 2026 alone.

  • 32% growth in business customers: Enterprise accounts drove most of the momentum in July.

  • About $1 billion ad run rate: OpenAI's advertising business is nearing that pace, roughly six months after it began testing ads in ChatGPT in February 2026, according to Unite.AI.

content_html_zh:
和平隆格

2026 年 8 月 17 日星期一中午 12:17 CDT 阅读时间 5 分钟

OpenAI 多年来一直因一件事而闻名：ChatGPT，以及每天有数百万人在其中输入问题。

然而，这不再是其大部分资金的来源。

2026 年 8 月 14 日星期五，OpenAI 首席财务官 Sarah Friar 会见了投资者，并告诉他们，公司的企业业务现在带来的收入超过了消费者业务。

时机很突出。 同一周，两名高级管理人员刚刚离开公司。

这对于任何在可能公开上市之前关注 OpenAI 的人来说都很重要，并且它改变了该公司作为一项投资的外观。

Sarah Friar 告诉 OpenAI 投资者，企业收入现在超过了消费者收入

Sarah Friar 向投资者传达了 OpenAI 如何赚钱的明确信息。

据 CNBC 报道，一位参加会议的人士表示，Friar 表示，企业收入和消费者收入在年初以 60 比 40 的比例向消费者倾斜，现在“已经交叉”。

她补充说，OpenAI 现在的大部分收入来自企业客户。

“企业”是指商业客户，例如购买 ChatGPT Enterprise 席位或付费在自己的软件中使用 OpenAI 模型的公司。

“消费者”是指支付 ChatGPT 订阅费用的个人，例如每月 20 美元的 Plus 套餐。

交叉来得很快。 2026 年伊始，OpenAI 60% 的收入来自消费者，40% 来自企业业务。

弗里尔此前曾表示，双方将在今年年底前打成平手。

OpenAI 企业转型背后的收入数字

Friar 分享的数据表明整个业务的快速增长。

OpenAI 的年收入已达到 400 亿美元。 仅 7 月份这一数字就增长了 20%，同月企业客户数量增长了 32%。

年化运行率的工作原理如下：将一个月的收入相乘，就好像今年每个月看起来都一样一样。

它显示了该公司目前的发展速度有多快。 它并不承诺今年的总金额实际上会达到这个总数。

8 月 14 日会议上的 OpenAI 主要收入数据

  • CNBC 证实，年化运行速度为 400 亿美元：大约是 2025 年底的两倍。
  • 环比增长 20%：仅 2026 年 7 月，公司总收入增速就增长了这么多。
  • 企业客户增长 32%：企业客户推动了 7 月份的大部分增长势头。
  • 广告运行率约为 10 亿美元：据 Unite.AI 称，自 2026 年 2 月开始在 ChatGPT 中测试广告大约六个月后，OpenAI 的广告业务已接近这一速度。
